subject: Temporal-life religious criterion
source: Lovejoy The Dialectic of Bruno and Spinoza pp146-147
documented_finding: Lovejoy says the serious religious issue is whether spiritual interests stand apart from common natural relationships or are realized through human business and temporal endeavor.
evidence_limit: Does not establish a causal relation to Lovejoy's settlement or institutional activity.

subject: Metaphysical otherworldliness and value
source: Lovejoy The Dialectic of Bruno and Spinoza pp173-174
documented_finding: Lovejoy condemns metaphysical otherworldliness for making genuine reality and worth the blank negation rather than fulfilment or explanation of common temporal experience.
evidence_limit: Targets a metaphysical pattern not a single religion or civilization.

subject: Social service as alternative to evangelical religion
source: Daniel J Wilson annotated bibliography introduction scan JSON p18
documented_finding: Wilson says Lovejoy came to view philosophy and social service as viable alternatives to evangelical religion and began settlement-house involvement at Berkeley.
evidence_limit: Secondary retrospective account; does not prove psychological causation for later philosophy.

subject: Harvard public spirit and social services
documented_finding: Wilson summarizes Some Harvard Notes as praising Harvard public spirit social services religious observances and graduate education.
evidence_limit: Primary article should be recovered before using exact argumentative language beyond Wilson's summary.

subject: French university as social organism
documented_finding: Wilson says Lovejoy judges the university both as an instrument of scholarship and as a member of a complicated social organism and criticizes weak social training and personal responsibility while praising its democratic role.
evidence_limit: Secondary summary; exact nuances require the 1900 primary text.

subject: Government syllabus collective industry
source: Wilson syllabus entry246 scan JSON p128
documented_finding: Wilson records a four-lecture syllabus treating distribution of political power and distribution of the collective industry of society.
evidence_limit: Syllabus summary does not reconstruct lecture content beyond the stated topics.

subject: International ethics general welfare
documented_finding: Wilson summarizes Lovejoy's international ethics as applying systematic ethical science to intervention and aiming external policy at the general well-being of mankind.
evidence_limit: Primary article required for page-level argument and qualifications.

subject: Nonsectarian university and free society
documented_finding: Wilson summarizes Lovejoy's defense of nonsectarian nonpartisan higher education and academic freedom as indispensable to a progressive and free society.
evidence_limit: Secondary summary and not a substitute for the primary article.

subject: Structural convergence
source: Primary Lovejoy 1904 plus Wilson biographical and bibliographic controls
documented_finding: Metaphysical valuation of temporal participation coexists with repeated institutional and social-service emphasis on responsibility collective welfare and active public life.
evidence_limit: Convergence is not evidence of causal direction among behavior institutional writing and metaphysical doctrine.
